incremental.bootstrap_policy: Requires explicit bounded --from when no same-target receipt-backed checkpoint exists; first run is limited to 366 calendar days and the code target must be empty.
incremental.revision_overlap: Re-fetch up to five calendar days before verified-through, clamped to the frozen bootstrap anchor.
incremental.checkpoint_policy: Only contiguous same-target/same-definition VERIFIED or VERIFIED_EMPTY incremental source receipts for the same frozen code advance the watermark; BACKFILL and RECONCILE do not advance it.
incremental.target_range_policy: Freeze static-v2 target identity and pre-run per-code physical min/max. Before planning, compare all existing physical keys and fields with the latest complete verified raw receipt covering each date; unexplained target rows/values fail closed.

mapping_drift.source_and_physical_columns: 12 fields map one-to-one: ts_code SYMBOL, trade_date TIMESTAMP, and ten nullable DOUBLE metrics.
mapping_drift.date_semantics: trade_date is YYYYMMDD business date stored as a UTC-midnight TIMESTAMP carrier; it is not an instant.
mapping_drift.numeric_values: total_mv/float_mv are yuan; total_share/float_share/free_share are shares; turnover_rate/turnover_rate_f preserve provider percentage values; pe/pe_ttm/pb remain ratios. No scaling or sentinel substitution; null stays null, nonfinite rejected.
mapping_drift.source_revocations: Before any page is consumed, full source keys must cover existing keys in that code/date window; omission including empty withdrawal fails without sending or advancing checkpoint. Explicit replacement is not claimed.
mapping_drift.schema: Audited YEAR partition, WAL enabled, DEDUP UPSERT (ts_code,trade_date). No formal-table DDL or Flyway migration; isolated-table DDL only.
